readings.Aries: The shortcut exists. It will cost you something you didn't account for. Worth knowing now. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Taurus: You build things to last. Check whether what you've built still wants to last. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Gemini: Something you said lightly is being taken seriously. Check in. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Cancer: Your memory holds things gently that others would have dropped. Today that gift is needed. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Leo: The recognition you crave is available in the form of self-recognition. It lasts longer. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Virgo: You have spent considerable energy on a detail that no longer matters. Redirect. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Libra: You process conflict by distancing from it. Right now, proximity would serve you better. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Scorpio: You contain multitudes of darkness and light and you've learned not to be afraid of either. Teach someone. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Sagittarius: You are better at starting than finishing. This particular thing deserves to be finished. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Capricorn: The authority in the room is not always the loudest voice. Yours rarely is. Today it should be. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Aquarius: You are more affected by the people around you than your detachment makes it appear. That's not a flaw. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Pisces: You have given people the version of yourself they could handle. Show someone the rest. The first instinct was right.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
